notes.title: Update Note – Performance Improvement
notes.content: We've made a small update to improve load times in Director Mode by streamlining some visual effects. This should result in a smoother experience when entering scenes.

notes.title: ✨ Visual Update: Swirl & Glow Enhancements
notes.content:
We've added some mystic visual upgrades to deepen your experience in Director Mode:

🌀 What’s New:

New animated swirl background adds a subtle sense of cosmic motion and energy

Enhanced glowing aura behind scene videos for increased drama and focus

Improved visual layering for smoother card assignment moments

These upgrades are purely aesthetic,  no gameplay changes, but they make the energy of the reading space feel more alive and arcane than ever.

Let the stars swirl and the glow guide you. 🌙

notes.title: New Feature Announcement: Director’s Mode is Here - Actors in a Tarot Drama
notes.content:
In this new game mode, you'll:

📺 Watch fully voiced video scenes, unique narratives full of tension, romance, betrayal, and mystery.

🃏 Assign tarot cards to each character based on their behavior and energy.

🌑 Interpret reversed and upright cards with new visual cues and scoring mechanics.

✍️ Log your results in your Oracle Journal and track your intuitive growth.

⭐ Score up to 9 Insight Points per scene. Earn high ranks and unlock deeper lore.

Each scene is a test of your intuition and a story only the wise will fully see.

🔮 What Makes Director’s Mode Special?
🎞 Original short films, voiced and edited for immersive oracle play

💬 Real-life dilemmas: jealousy, loyalty, awakening, secrets, and more

🌌 Choose from a card pool of upright and reversed tarot

🧠 New scoring system rewarding accuracy, insight, and symbolic alignment

🧙 Ready to take your training to the next level?

🔓 Find Director’s Mode under the Trainer Menu after updating!

Whether you’re a Supreme Oracle or just starting your path, this mode will test your heart, your logic, and your understanding of the human soul.

notes.title: 🔮 New Update: Director’s Mode Unlocked!
notes.content:
Get ready to experience Tarot Awakening in a bold new way Director’s Mode is now live!

Step beyond the cards and into the story. In this immersive new mode, you’ll watch dramatic life scenes unfold and assign tarot cards to each character based on their energy, choices, and hidden motives. Every scene is a prophecy waiting to be interpreted, can you uncover the truth?
